title: KAFKA-20999: [1/N] Add RackAwareStandbyPicker for rack-aware standby placement
body:
First part of rack-aware standby placement for streams groups. It adds
RackAwareStandbyPicker, which the sticky assignor and balanced assignor
will use to place standbys by rack.aware.assignment.tags. Nothing calls
it yet; the next PR wires it into StickyTaskAssignor.

A process meets a tag key when it has a value for it that no holder of
the task has yet. For the next standby of a task, pick() chooses the
conditions: every tag key with an unused value if a process with room
meets them all; otherwise, the tag keys in configured order, each kept
only if a process with room still meets it together with those kept so
far. It returns the conditions together with the least-loaded process
with room that meets them, or null once no process with room can make
the task more diverse.

The processes sit in a tree with one level per tag key, so a pick does
not scan every combination of tag values. Each node keeps the
least-loaded process with room below it, and its children are ordered by
it. The caller reports load and room changes with updated() and
updatedAll(), which repair only the affected paths.

Reviewers: Lucas Brutschy <lbrutschy@confluent.io>
